prompts.content: Photorealistic lifestyle DSLR shot of the uploaded image as the subject casually seated at an upscale modern café with warm ambient lighting. Soft golden indoor tones, shallow depth of field with elegant background blur. Subject wears a refined smart-casual outfit — knit polo shirt, slim-fit trousers, minimalist sneakers. Natural candid pose, one arm resting on the table, subtle confident expression. Ultra-detailed facial features, realistic skin texture, premium lifestyle magazine aesthetic, 85mm lens, f/1.8, cinematic color balance.

prompts.content: A realistic, candid full-body photo of a young man, use my face exact my reference image, leaning casually against the hood of a modified white Toyota Supra MK4 at night. Same beard, He has messy, wavy black hair (wolf cut) and is looking directly at the camera with a calm expression. He is wearing a silver chain necklace, an oversized dark charcoal grey corduroy crewneck sweatshirt with the text "NEOPALESCENT" inside an oval logo on the chest, baggy loose-fitting black denim jeans, and tan suede boots. His hands are in his pockets. The background is a gritty urban street corner with a concrete wall heavily covered in graffiti tags and Afux on wall. The lighting is "direct camera flash" style, creating hard shadows behind the subject and a high-contrast, vintage 90s streetwear aesthetic. 4k resolution, raw photo style, flash photography.

prompts.title: 古埃及祭祀外星实体提示
prompts.description: 一个用于 Nano Banana Pro 的详细英文提示，用于生成一张图片，然后该图片在 Higgsfield Cinema Studio 2.0 中被用于制作视频。该提示描述了一个古埃及的单色、仪式性场景，其中涉及一场仪仗队、神圣几何图案，以及一个巨大、令人不安的异形实体主宰着整个场景。
prompts.content: Monochrome ritualistic scene set in ancient Egypt, a ceremonial procession of ancient Egyptian people moving a massive square stone block as part of a sacred rite, bodies arranged in deliberate patterns, synchronized movements, sand disturbed like ritual markings. A gigantic alien entity presides over the scene like an ancient god. Its skin is thick and cracked like elephant hide, aged and primordial; its legs are impossibly thin and unnaturally long like a deer’s, elevating its body into an inhuman silhouette. The face is deeply unsettling, elongated and expressionless, evoking Anunnaki-like beings and forgotten star gods. The alien radiates silent authority, worshipped rather than feared. High-contrast lighting, deep shadows, sacred geometry in composition, mythological atmosphere, surreal historical ritual, solemn and ominous mood, timeless and forbidden

prompts.content:
'Use the uploaded reference image as the composition and pose reference.
Use my uploaded face photo as the ONLY face reference for the main character.

100% identity lock: same eyes, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, hair texture. No change in ethnicity or facial structure. Real human photorealism, no Al plastic look.

Create a photorealistic cinematic portrait replicating the exact composition, pose, and surreal concept of the reference image. The main female subject is sitting cross-legged on a wooden floor with a warm smile.

She wears the identical red top puff sleeevs, denim jeans and yellow sneakers shoes . Surround him with seven miniature, realistic versions of himself (all sharing my face reference with slightly enlarged heads and playful expressions).

Two miniatures stand on her upturned palms, two sit on her shoulders, one pushes at her right shoe, one runs in the foreground, and one hugs her left knee from behind, matching the poses and placement from the reference image precisely.

Soft high-quality studio lighting creates realistic soft shadows. Background: clean gradient grey studio wall.

Ultra-sharp, highly detailed textures, cinematic depth, photorealistic lighting, 8K quality, natural skin texture, no CGI look.

Negative prompt: cartoon, 3D render, anime, chibi, painting, drawing, low quality, blurry, distorted face, bad anatomy, extra fingers, missing limbs, mismatched faces, different clothing colors, warped proportions, artifacts.

Aspect ratio: 4:5'
